notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. Documents read on sec.gov: FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000886982-25-000005) and 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-25-054559). LLOYD BLANKFEIN (former CEO) does not appear anywhere in the 2025 proxy, including its beneficial-ownership table, so status is no-reported-stake. HOLDERS: percentages are as the proxy states them, derived from each holder's Schedule 13G filings; asOf is the date of the latest amendment the proxy cites (the filing date, not the event date), so they date from early 2024. DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow statement reports a single line covering common stock, preferred stock and dividend equivalents on share-based awards ($4,497 million), and the 10-K gives no separate cash-paid figure for common only, so the combined figure is used. Preferred dividends recognized in 2024 were $717 million (XBRL DividendsPreferredStock). BUYBACKS: common stock only; the $2,200 million 'Preferred stock redemption' and $1,331 million of shares withheld to settle employee tax obligations are excluded. STOCK COMP: $2,772 million is the share-based compensation expense in Note 29. The cash-flow non-cash adjustment is $2,663 million (XBRL ShareBasedCompensation); the Note 29 figure is not tagged with a standard XBRL concept, so no xbrl object is given. GEOGRAPHY: the note says substantially all Americas amounts are attributable to the U.S. and Asia includes Australia and New Zealand. The 10-K text contains no mention of an employee stock purchase plan, so plan is null.
